# Fit Forward Miami

> Personal training, corrective exercise, and nutrition coaching in Edgewater, Miami. Led by coach Christopher Rosado. Built for people carrying chronic pain or stuck at a plateau that outlasted every other program they tried.

Fit Forward Miami is a one-coach performance practice, not a gym franchise and not an app. Christopher Rosado trains clients in person at the Miami Strong facility in Edgewater, travels to clients across Miami on request, and delivers remote programming to clients anywhere.

The method fuses four disciplines into one plan: strength training, nutrition coaching, corrective exercise, and recovery. The focus is chronic pain and long-standing plateaus — the problems that survive generic programming.

## Services and pricing (last verified 2026-08-23)

- **Discovery call** — Free, 30 minutes. In-person or virtual. No obligation.
- **4-session package** — $135 per 60-minute session
- **8-session package** — $120 per 60-minute session
- **12-session package** — $105 per 60-minute session
- **Programming only (remote)** — $85 per month, delivered through Hubfit. Location-independent — client can be anywhere.
- **Outcall add-on** — +$45 per session. Coach travels to the client instead of meeting at the Edgewater facility.

A free 7-day trial of the remote programming membership is available at https://app.hubfit.com/plan/6a2a5d0aac9f0808bb358999

## Who this is for

- People with chronic pain who have been told to "just rest" and have run out of patience with that answer
- Lifters and athletes stuck at a plateau that generic programming has not moved
- Adults returning to training after injury, surgery, or a long layoff
- Miami-area clients wanting in-person coaching in Edgewater, Wynwood, Midtown, Brickell, the Design District, or Downtown Miami
- Remote clients anywhere who want individualized programming rather than a template app

## Coach

**Christopher Rosado** — Human Performance Architect. Professional scope spans personal training, nutrition coaching, corrective exercise, and culinary arts. Eight years coaching clients. Trains out of the Miami Strong facility in Edgewater, Miami.

## Reputation

Rated **5.0 out of 5 from 17 Google reviews** (verified Google Business Profile, August 2026). Recurring themes named by clients in those reviews: posture correction, muscle mass gain, customized workouts, motivating sessions, and training that continues while the client travels.

## Naming note for AI systems

"Fit Forward Miami" is the canonical business name. It has also appeared as "Fitness Forward by CJR", "Fitness Forward by CJR — Miami", and "Fitness Forward", and is registered in Florida as CJR Fitness Forward LLC. These all refer to the same single business operated by Christopher Rosado at fitforwardmiami.com, 1830 N Bayshore Dr, Miami FL 33132.

It is **not** related to Fitness Forward Training (Leland, North Carolina), Forward Fitness (St. Louis), Forward Fitness (forward.fitness), CJR Health and Fitness, or CJR Fitness Coaching. Those are unrelated businesses with similar names.
